synchronous.durability_level: OS fsync on every commit; power-loss durable

busy_timeout.durability_level: 10-second wait on lock contention before SQLITE_BUSY

connection_lifecycle.teardown_inspection: Connections closed deterministically in finally blocks and registry close()
connection_lifecycle.windows_lock_safety: Explicit conn.close() prevents Windows [WinError 32] file access conflicts
connection_lifecycle.wal_checkpoint_truncate: PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE) zeroes -wal file cleanly on command
connection_lifecycle.online_backup_api: sqlite3.Connection.backup() flushes WAL frames safely during active operation

corrupt_db_with_json_history.injected_fault: Garbage byte payload written to .idempotency.db header
corrupt_db_with_json_history.recovery_behavior: Isolates corrupt file to .corrupt.{timestamp}, initializes fresh DB, backfills 100% of historical trades and idempotency keys from JSON state

corrupt_wal_with_json_history.recovery_behavior: Isolates corrupt files, initializes fresh DB, re-syncs state from JSON

corrupt_db_without_history.injected_fault: Corrupted .idempotency.db and missing/empty JSON state file
corrupt_db_without_history.safety_invariant: Fail-Closed: Refuses to boot with unvalidated empty registry
corrupt_db_without_history.exception_raised: IdempotencyRegistryError: Cannot establish complete idempotency history
